= AsciiDoc Cells and Cell Span

== a| AsciiDoc cells

The `a|` prefix on a row makes that cell's content parse recursively as
nested AsciiDoc blocks instead of a flat run of inlines.

|===
| plain cell
a| An *AsciiDoc* cell with `inline code` and _emphasis_.
|===

== Column span

[cols="1,1,1"]
|===
| A  | B  | C
2+| spans columns 1 and 2 | end
| x  | y  | z
|===

== Column span at end of row

[cols="1,1,1"]
|===
| top-left | top-mid | top-right
| only one 2+| spans the last two columns
|===
